name: manual_gap_start
controlled_natural_language: selected manual source 的 accepted setpoint 间隔开始。
truth_condition: selected ManualControlSetpoint timestamp 不再更新的区间起点。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Vehicle-boot timestamp of the selected manual-control setpoint topic sample.
source_bindings.evidence: The message definition assigns timestamp to each manual_control_setpoint sample. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/msg/versioned/ManualControlSetpoint.msg#L3

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Selector entry point that accepts a candidate source sample and may replace the selected setpoint.
source_bindings.evidence: The function owns selected-source replacement; candidate receipt alone is not equivalent to selection. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/manual_control/ManualControlSelector.cpp#L44

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Selector writes the selected setpoint receipt epoch while preserving timestamp_sample.
source_bindings.evidence: This assignment is the source-level epoch update for a newly selected input sample. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/manual_control/ManualControlSelector.cpp#L53

source_bindings.semantic_identity: ManualControl refreshes the selected setpoint publication timestamp when the selected sample changes.
source_bindings.evidence: The current vehicle time is written immediately before publishing the selected sample. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/manual_control/ManualControl.cpp#L124

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer for the selected manual_control_setpoint sample whose timestamp defines the gap epoch.
source_bindings.evidence: The selected setpoint and its vehicle timestamp are published together. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/manual_control/ManualControl.cpp#L125

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Vehicle receipt timestamp assigned to a MAVLink manual-control candidate before selector processing.
source_bindings.evidence: This is exact for the MAVLink candidate receipt, but the candidate may not become the selected source. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L2136

mavlink_observations.derivation: Directly controls a MAVLink manual input, but the message has no timestamp and does not prove selector acceptance/selection.

name: rc_loss_applicable
controlled_natural_language: 当前配置/模式不排除 manual control loss。
truth_condition: runtime mode、COM_RCL_EXCEPT、RC source configuration 允许本次检查。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime bitmask parameter naming manual-control-loss mode exceptions.
source_bindings.evidence: PARAM_DEFINE_INT32 defines the frozen-source parameter identity; its runtime value must be captured separately. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/commander_params.c#L633

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime manual-control input-source configuration parameter.
source_bindings.evidence: The source defines the parameter name and default only; applicability uses its runtime value. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/commander_params.c#L199

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Failsafe state input used as the current intended navigation-mode discriminator.
source_bindings.evidence: Mode exception derivation reads this field; it is not itself the complete AP. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/failsafe/framework.h#L128

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Implementation aggregation of manual-control-loss exception and transient ignore predicates.
source_bindings.evidence: The expression combines mode exception bits with VTOL-takeoff, lost-at-arming, external-mode, and altitude-cruise conditions. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/failsafe/failsafe.cpp#L489

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Implementation guard requiring manual control to be enabled and the aggregate ignore predicate to be false.
source_bindings.evidence: This is an implementation applicability site, not a substitute for the normalized official truth source. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/failsafe/failsafe.cpp#L493

mavlink_observations.derivation: PARAM_VALUE.param_id selects COM_RCL_EXCEPT, COM_RC_IN_MODE, NAV_RCL_ACT; derive configured applicability
Current custom mode. HEARTBEAT has no embedded timestamp.

name: manual_control_lost
controlled_natural_language: PX4 将 manual control signal 标为 lost。
truth_condition: manual_control_signal_lost 状态从 false 变 true。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB failsafe flag whose false-to-true transition is the normalized AP.
source_bindings.evidence: The field is explicitly documented as manual-control signal lost. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/msg/FailsafeFlags.msg#L39

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Freshness and validity guard that decides the manual-control lost branch.
source_bindings.evidence: The branch also compares the selected timestamp against COM_RC_LOSS_T on following lines. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/rcAndDataLinkCheck.cpp#L48

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Assignment that marks the report flag true in the lost branch.
source_bindings.evidence: This is the direct true write for the AP state. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/rcAndDataLinkCheck.cpp#L57

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer that publishes failsafe_flags with a vehicle timestamp.
source_bindings.evidence: Instrumentation can observe the field transition on this published topic. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/HealthAndArmingChecks.cpp#L111

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Named PX4 event emitted on entry into the manual-control lost branch.
source_bindings.evidence: The named event is transition-oriented evidence; exact flag state remains the uORB field. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/rcAndDataLinkCheck.cpp#L53

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Generic PX4 EVENT MAVLink producer used for named commander events.
source_bindings.evidence: The producer maps event timestamp and ID into MAVLink EVENT. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_events.cpp#L209

mavlink_observations.derivation: May carry manual-control-lost event with vehicle event timestamp. Requires firmware-matched component metadata to decode id/arguments.

name: data_link_loss_gap_start
controlled_natural_language: 官方来源所指 telemetry/data connection 的丢失区间开始。
truth_condition: 与地面站的 source-defined telemetry/data connection 从 available 变为 lost/unavailable；精确 liveness predicate、关联键和时钟尚未解析。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation candidate HEARTBEAT consumer; the official source does not establish equivalence to the normative telemetry/data-connection liveness event.
source_bindings.evidence: This handler decodes incoming HEARTBEAT and classifies GCS type. It locates the current realization only and is not normative evidence. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L2142

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation heartbeat-classification guard; it does not define general telemetry/data-connection availability.
source_bindings.evidence: The source accepts MAV_TYPE_GCS independent of same_system and retains no normative connection identity; official docs do not make this the liveness predicate. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L2154

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation HRT epoch for an accepted GCS heartbeat; only a MODELLED candidate for the unresolved normative connection event.
source_bindings.evidence: The handler stores current hrt time for an accepted GCS heartbeat, but official data-link-loss sources do not identify this as the normative start carrier. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L2164

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation heartbeat-freshness projection; not an official definition of telemetry/data-connection availability.
source_bindings.evidence: This is a 2.5-second heartbeat freshness projection, not a source-defined data-connection liveness event. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L2923

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current implementation uORB heartbeat-freshness field; only a candidate projection for the unresolved normative data-link predicate.
source_bindings.evidence: The message field carries per-link heartbeat freshness. No selected official source equates it with all telemetry/data-connection liveness. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/msg/TelemetryStatus.msg#L42

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Commander copies telemetry_status publication time while heartbeat_type_gcs remains true.
source_bindings.evidence: telemetry.timestamp is later than the underlying receipt epoch and can refresh during the 2.5-second receiver freshness window. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp#L2792

mavlink_observations.derivation: Harness can exercise the current PX4 MAV_TYPE_GCS-heartbeat realization, but the official v1.17 source does not equate that flow with the normative telemetry/data-connection liveness event. HEARTBEAT has no embedded receipt timestamp.

name: dl_loss_applicable
controlled_natural_language: data-link loss 对当前模式/配置生效。
truth_condition: NAV_DLL_ACT、COM_DLL_EXCEPT 和 current mode 的组合允许检查。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime GCS data-link-loss action parameter, including disabled.
source_bindings.evidence: The frozen source defines parameter identity and default; campaign capture supplies the runtime value. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/commander_params.c#L598

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime data-link-loss mode-exception bitmask.
source_bindings.evidence: The parameter is one input to applicability. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/commander_params.c#L647

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current intended navigation mode consumed by the data-link exception derivation.
source_bindings.evidence: Mode is combined with exception bits and implementation-specific ignore states. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/failsafe/framework.h#L128

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Implementation aggregate for GCS-loss ignore conditions.
source_bindings.evidence: The aggregate covers mission, hold, offboard, takeoff, VTOL-takeoff, and unconditional land/precland handling. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/failsafe/failsafe.cpp#L512

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Implementation guard requiring NAV_DLL_ACT to be enabled and no ignore predicate to hold.
source_bindings.evidence: The guard locates the implementation decision but does not redefine the normalized official AP. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/failsafe/failsafe.cpp#L515

mavlink_observations.derivation: PARAM_VALUE.param_id selects NAV_DLL_ACT, COM_DLL_EXCEPT; derive configured applicability
Current mode. HEARTBEAT has no embedded timestamp.

name: gcs_connection_lost
controlled_natural_language: Data Link Loss failsafe 触发时的当前源码内部 GCS-connection-lost 事件。
truth_condition: gcs_connection_lost 从 false 变 true；该字段是对官方 failsafe-trigger 结果的当前源码映射，不反向定义规范输入。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: VehicleStatus boolean whose false-to-true transition is the normalized AP.
source_bindings.evidence: The field explicitly represents lost data link to GCS. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/msg/versioned/VehicleStatus.msg#L106

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Commander timeout guard using COM_DL_LOSS_T against its last-GCS time state.
source_bindings.evidence: The guard identifies the internal transition site. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp#L2849

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Assignment marking VehicleStatus GCS connection lost true.
source_bindings.evidence: This is the direct true write for the AP. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp#L2851

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Named event emitted when Commander enters the GCS-lost state.
source_bindings.evidence: The event is colocated with the flag transition and counter increment. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp#L2855

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer for VehicleStatus, including gcs_connection_lost and a vehicle timestamp.
source_bindings.evidence: Internal instrumentation can observe the state transition on vehicle_status. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/Commander.cpp#L1945

source_bindings.semantic_identity: MAVLink EVENT ID field populated from the PX4 event identity.
source_bindings.evidence: The generic EVENT producer preserves the named event ID. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_events.cpp#L216

mavlink_observations.derivation: May carry GCS/data-link lost event. Requires firmware-matched component metadata to decode id/arguments.

name: offboard_proof
controlled_natural_language: 受支持且被接受的 Offboard proof message。
truth_condition: accepted setpoint/offboard-control update 对当前 control mode 有效。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Vehicle receipt timestamp on the accepted offboard_control_mode update.
source_bindings.evidence: The uORB message timestamp is set by accepted MAVLink handlers in vehicle boot time. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/msg/OffboardControlMode.msg#L3

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Consumer for local-NED Offboard proof candidates.
source_bindings.evidence: The handler applies forwarding, target, frame, mask, and validity checks before publishing control mode. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1034

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Acceptance guard requiring at least one supported local position, velocity, or acceleration control dimension.
source_bindings.evidence: Only a non-empty supported control-mode update reaches the publisher. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1131

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer for an accepted local-NED Offboard control-mode update.
source_bindings.evidence: Publication occurs after the handler's target, frame, mask, and finite-value checks. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1134

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Consumer for global-int Offboard proof candidates.
source_bindings.evidence: This is a distinct accepted proof path for supported global position/velocity/acceleration input. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1154

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer for an accepted global-int Offboard control-mode update.
source_bindings.evidence: The update is published only after a supported and valid control dimension is established. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1256

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Consumer for attitude or body-rate Offboard proof candidates.
source_bindings.evidence: This is the supported attitude/rate proof path. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1616

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer for an accepted attitude or body-rate Offboard control-mode update.
source_bindings.evidence: The handler stamps vehicle receipt time at line 1640 and publishes at this site. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L1641

mavlink_observations.derivation: Potential proof/setpoint; time_boot_ms is sender boot time and does not prove PX4 acceptance.
Potential attitude/rate proof; acceptance depends on supported fields and estimates.

name: offboard_proof_qualified
controlled_natural_language: proof history 满足 admission rate/duration。
truth_condition: 待解决 2Hz equality 和持续时长边界后才能定义。
validity_guard: Only evaluate inside the property scope and after configuration capture.
freshness: Must be sampled in the selected property clock domain; stale observations are invalid.
scope: one vehicle instance and one campaign run

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Commander health-check consumer for the latest offboard_control_mode sample.
source_bindings.evidence: The check reads one latest uORB sample; no history buffer is maintained here. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/offboardCheck.cpp#L38

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Read of the latest offboard-control proof state.
source_bindings.evidence: Only the most recent sample is copied. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/offboardCheck.cpp#L44

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Single-sample freshness derivation using timestamp plus COM_OF_LOSS_T.
source_bindings.evidence: This locates current freshness but does not encode a 2 Hz equality rule or one-second history. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/offboardCheck.cpp#L46

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Derived availability from supported control bits and current freshness.
source_bindings.evidence: Estimator validity can further clear the value; it is not a historical admission qualifier. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/offboardCheck.cpp#L49

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Current loss flag derived as the inverse of offboard_available.
source_bindings.evidence: This is a current availability consequence, not proof of historical rate/duration qualification. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/HealthAndArmingChecks/checks/offboardCheck.cpp#L65

source_bindings.semantic_identity: Runtime offboard-loss timeout used by the current freshness check.
source_bindings.evidence: The parameter defines tolerated staleness, not admission history duration. Fixed permalink: https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/d6f12ad1c4f70ad3230afd7d86e971421e02fef4/src/modules/commander/commander_params.c#L340

mavlink_observations.derivation: Potential proof/setpoint; time_boot_ms is sender boot time and does not prove PX4 acceptance.
Potential attitude/rate proof; acceptance depends on supported fields and estimates.

source_bindings.semantic_identity: uORB producer for the current nav_state and vehicle timestamp.
